title: HOI4 Live Tools campaign plan
description: plan.json for the standing-plan executor (native/src/plan_run.rs) and the player. Every top-level key carries x-owner: executor (the executor reads it today) or player (the player acts on it from the brief). x-executor-planned names the build item (coverage audit section 6, W1-n / W2-n) whose executor step takes a player key over; the owner flips to executor when that step lands (x-planned-owner is the older marker). Unknown top-level keys are errors except _-prefixed ones. tests/test_plan_schema.py keeps this file in step with plan_run.rs.

campaign.description: campaign identity; plan_state.json is ignored for another campaign

source.description: who wrote the plan: hand plans get the coverage-build lint rules as warnings (lint_plan.py --hand does the same)

_meta.description: Plan metadata for the strategist and the revision protocol (version is the compare-and-swap key).

_coverage.description: Strategist checklist coverage (coverage audit section 3, items c1..c29): each id maps to key:<plan key>[,<key>...] (an executor or player key of this plan holds the decision), call or call:<key> (a player item with an exact tool call), md:<plan.md section> (text only) or na:<reason> (not applicable, with the reason). Never read by the executor; lint_plan.py coverage.checklist checks it.

id.description: Stable item id (a string, or a number). The executor keys its done-memory on it (plan_run.rs item_id, plan_state.json), so a revision keeps the id of an unchanged item and never reuses one.

date.description: Game date YYYY.MM.DD (dots or dashes); a trailing hour field is ignored.

trigger.description: Executor trigger read today (plan_run.rs construction_plan_step): empty (always), a date, province_controlled:<province>, state_fully_controlled:<state> or owner:<state>=<TAG>.

x-grammar: string     := comparison | flag | date | ""       ("" holds always)
comparison := name[:arg] op value   (spaces around op optional; op is < <= > >= == !=)
flag       := name[:arg]            (a yes/no atom: x-atoms kind bool; negate with {"not": ...})
date       := YYYY.MM.DD | date:YYYY.MM.DD   (reached; same as date >= YYYY.MM.DD)
value      := number -?D[.D][%] for kind number; a date for kind date; a TAG for kind tag
kind tag   := owner|controller|state_controller:<state>, province_controller:<province> with == or != TAG
(a single = is ==: the older owner:<state>=<TAG> form)
ratio      := atoms with ratio: true are fractions 0..1; a value above 1, or written with %, is a percent
arg        := province|state: digits; tag: [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2}; key: [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+; id: [A-Za-z0-9_]+;
branch: army|air|navy (land, naval accepted); army: an army or army_layout name_hint (no < > = !
and no edge spaces); equipment: [A-Za-z0-9_]+; name: [A-Za-z0-9_.@^:]+ (script variable)
evaluation := three-valued: an atom that cannot be read now is unknown, never true, and whatever waits on
it waits; all is false when one part is false, else unknown when one is unknown; any is the
x-atoms    := every atom: kind, arg, min/max, ratio, unit, the read that answers it; readable: false marks
the atoms that are always unknown today (lint predicates.unreadable); legacy_of names the
current atom an older spelling stands for
predicate.description: A check on the game state, as native/src/plan_predicate.rs parses it: a string `atom op value` (ops < <= > >= == !=) or a bare yes/no atom, combined as {"all":[...]}, {"any":[...]}, {"not": p} (a plain list is all). x-grammar is the grammar, x-atoms the atom table; hoi4facts/validate.py parse_predicate implements both.
